translation.question: ¿Qué figura clave firmó los Acuerdos de Paz de Washington en su calidad de ministro de Relaciones Exteriores de la RDC?
translation.translation_note: RDC is the standard Spanish abbreviation for DRC (República Democrática del Congo). 'Ministro de Relaciones Exteriores' is the standard translation for foreign minister.

backtranslation_en.question: What key figure signed the Washington Peace Agreements in their capacity as Minister of Foreign Affairs of the DRC?
